messages.author: b99c3afec07fcf78
messages.subject: Real-time update plots with Shiny
parts:
I am looking for a way to integrate Shiny with my stream of data. 
I am using a call back function to update my dataframe when I see new data point coming in.

Could you please help me integrating with Shiny? 

Here is my code: 

mydata <- data.frame(x=numeric(),y=numeric())

alert <- function(x,y) {
  count = nrow(mydata)[1]
  mydata[count+1,] <<- c(x,y)
  # plot data
  p <- ggplot(mydata)
  plot(p)
}
